verse: Rejoice at all times. Pray without ceasing. Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
story: Paul closes his letter to a young church under pressure with three short commands, each of them stranger than it first sounds.

Rejoice at all times, pray without ceasing, give thanks in every circumstance. Paul is not asking for a cheerful face; the Thessalonians were being persecuted. He is asking for a settled habit of turning toward God, in the good hours and the hard ones. Notice that he says to give thanks in every circumstance, not for every circumstance. And he roots it in God's will for them in Christ Jesus, which means the strength to do it comes from Him and not from us.
Find one thing to thank Him for before you leave the house, then talk to Him as you go.
